primary: Most Act 3 entries on the 192 locked development lobby seeds
secondary: Most entries to the Act 2 boss, then most mean capped Act 2 floors reached
eligibility: Only voluntary changes to the policy inside Act 2 regular and elite fights; reproduce the finalist on complete natural development starts
fight_only_control: Compare the best non-identical pre-boss variant with the previous boss-escape policy even if development gains are inconclusive. Keep the published model as a second reference.
test: Exactly one selected candidate; 768 previously reserved, seeded, natural Silent A10 runs; two-sided paired discordance on entering Act 3
fit: Grouped native combat outcomes on archived training seeds. Development and test seeds excluded from every training receipt.
